name: browser-use
headline: Typst skill for advanced agent integration
short_description: Comprehensive Typst skill for Claude Code enabling document creation, compilation, and package development with support for Typst 0.15 and 0.14.2 compatibility.
author: lucifer1004

sections.overview:
The Typst skill for Claude Code provides a complete toolkit for working with Typst documents and packages directly within your AI agent workflows. It includes documentation on language fundamentals, styling, tables, academic content, CLI commands, and package development, plus built-in search tools for discovering Typst packages and API functions. The skill automatically activates when working with .typ files and supports both Typst 0.15 (default) and 0.14.2 via compatibility paths. Developers benefit from advanced features like state management, query introspection, performance profiling, and specialized verification agents for quality assurance. Users can compile documents to HTML, PNG, or PDF formats, and access runnable examples and templates for common document types.
Generating technical documentation and papers with citations
Creating data visualizations and charts in Typst
Building reusable Typst document templates and packages
Converting Markdown or LaTeX content to Typst format
